themes.name: Christmas Morning
themes.creator: Hollycast contributors
themes.description: A nostalgic Christmas room with ivory serif type, a cover list, cranberry and gold controls, and a CRT preview. Requires Hollycast with list badges and keyboard preview support; see README.

themes.name: Harvest Afterglow

themes.description: A candlelit Thanksgiving lodge with painted maple leaves, a harvest feast, cranberry and brass controls, storybook typography, a full-width cover gallery, a tall fireside list, fitted game descriptions, and a dedicated portrait layout.
